title: Compliance Analyst
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Compliance Analyst to join our team in Kerala. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring that our organization adheres to regulatory requirements and internal policies related to cyber security. As a Compliance Analyst, you will be responsible for monitoring compliance with laws and regulations, conducting audits, and providing recommendations for improvements. Key Responsibilities: - Conduct regular compliance audits and assessments to ensure adherence to cyber security regulations. - Collaborate with various departments to develop and implement compliance policies and procedures. - Analyze and report on compliance metrics to senior management. - Stay updated on changes in regulations and industry standards related to cyber security. - Provide training and support to staff on compliance-related issues. - Assist in the development of risk management strategies to mitigate compliance risks. Required Skills: - Strong understanding of compliance frameworks and regulations in the cyber security domain. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Ability to communicate effectively with various stakeholders. - Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills. - Proficiency in compliance management tools and software is a plus. If you are passionate about compliance and cyber security and are looking for an opportunity to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply for this position.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Litigation, Internal Audit - Senior, Internal Audit - Junior
description:
**Company Description**
Vimal Venu & Co is a dynamic firm of Chartered Accountants and Certified Fraud Examiners specializing in financial advisory, taxation, forensic accounting, fraud detection, and compliance services. The firm combines experience, research, analysis, and innovation to support clients in a competitive business environment. Vimal Venu & Co focuses on understanding each client’s specific needs and delivering customized solutions. Team members gain exposure to diverse industries and complex financial matters, contributing to both professional growth and client success.

**Role Description**
The Litigation, Internal Audit – Senior and Internal Audit – Junior roles are full-time, on-site positions based in Palakkad. These roles involve conducting financial and internal audits, reviewing financial records, preparing audit reports, and assisting in litigation-related documentation and analysis. Team members will evaluate internal controls, identify risks, support fraud detection activities, and recommend improvements in compliance and financial processes. Daily responsibilities include collaborating with other professionals, communicating findings to stakeholders, and maintaining accurate work papers and documentation. Seniors are expected to lead engagements, mentor junior team members, and liaise with clients, while juniors support audit execution, data collection, and report preparation.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong financial and analytical skills, including Finance and Analytical Skills.
* Candidates should possess robust audit capabilities, including experience with Financial Audits and preparation of Audit Reports.
* Candidates should possess effective interpersonal abilities, including clear written and verbal Communication.
* Relevant professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, or related degrees in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance are preferred.
* Knowledge of internal control frameworks, basic taxation concepts, and compliance standards will be beneficial.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, accounting software, and audit tools, along with attention to detail and integrity, is expected.
* Prior experience in internal audit, forensic accounting, or litigation support is an advantage, especially for the Senior role.
* For Litigation and Senior Position - CA/CMA qualified.

**Litigation - Key Responsibilities**

> Process and review GST & Income Tax notices

> Drafting and filing tax appeals

> Maintain litigation documents and ensure proper follow up

> Assist in statutory compliance and regulatory requirements.

> Liasing with internal team and authorities
